decisions.reason: This compact dumper extends the firm's established offer and still has its own page, so it meets aspirations without signs of problemistic search.
The articulated dumper fits the core construction business and keeps its own page, with no shortfall that would justify freeing its resources.

The rescue vehicle is distant from the core and was downgraded from its own page to a mention, which hints at weak results, but it is a niche specialty that slack in a growing industry can still carry for now.
This multi-model telescopic loader line builds on the established offer and remains prominently presented, a sign of sustained commitment.
The material lift line is described as the most popular in rental and just won a large order, so it clearly exceeds aspirations.
The underground loader shows strong quantified field performance (1,000 hours in 7 months), which supports keeping it despite its distance from the core.
